Calculation.Text: /* _Stubify ( pValues ; pDelim ; pJOpts ) Returns line contents before the delimiter (trimmed). For example _Stubify ( ScriptNames ( "" ) ; "(" ) returns script names without parameters. 20250925 @mrwatson-de v0.1 */ Case( IsEmpty( pDelim ) or pDelim = ¶ ; pValues ; While( [ vValues = pValues & ¶ ; vResult = "" ; vPosStart = 1 ; /* find the first delimiter */ vPosDelim = Position ( pValues ; pDelim ; vPosStart ; 1 ) ]; vPosDelim ;[ /* add everything up to the character before the next occurence - trimmed + an EOL */ vResult = vResult & Trim( Middle ( pValues ; vPosStart ; vPosDelim - vPosStart ) ) & ¶ ; /* skip past next ¶ */ vPosStart = Position ( vValues ; ¶ ; vPosDelim ; 1 ) + 1 ; /* find the next delimiter */ vPosDelim = Position ( pValues ; pDelim ; vPosStart ; 1 ) ]; /* and add the last bit too */ vResult & Middle ( pValues ; vPosStart ; Length ( pValues )+1 - vPosStart ) ))
